draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
rationale: Ferrule beats Arbor-GBT on 5 of 6 datasets (r1,r2,r4,r5,r6) but loses on r3 (Ivel-Fraud: 92.3 vs 92.8). "Generally" is defensible for 5/6, but the claim omits the one dataset where Arbor-GBT was higher. No statistical tests reported, so no significance language. The claim is accurate as stated with "generally".
